description:
Monthly count of online job advertisements for Australia and each state and territory since January 2006, by occupation group and by skill level.

Coverage: Australia and all 8 states and territories; monthly, January 2006 to September 2026 (249 months). Current to 2026-09-01. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/job-vacancies`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_ads, managers, professionals, technicians_trades, community_personal_service, clerical_admin, sales, machinery_drivers, labourers, skill_level_1, skill_level_2, skill_level_3, skill_level_4, skill_level_5. Omit for all.

state.description: State or territory abbreviation: nsw, vic, qld, sa, wa, tas, act or nt.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: states_economy_job_vacancies
title: State · Job advertisements over time
